screens.title: Volume breakout
screens.description: Price breaks above its recent range on unusually heavy volume, with most shares taken for delivery.
rules: Close above the highest high of the previous 20 sessions, or a new 52-week high
Volume at least 2× its 20-day average
Delivery at least 50% of traded volume
Traded value at least ₹1 crore; main board (EQ) and SME series only

screens.title: Fundamentally good
screens.description: Quality, growth, cash conversion, balance sheet and valuation from the last 3–4 annual reports. Free Yahoo data: check the annual report before acting.
rules: Quality (3 pts): ROCE ≥ 15% (2) and ROE ≥ 12% (1), averaged over the years available
Growth (2 pts): sales growth ≥ 12% a year (1); profit growth ≥ 12% a year and not lagging sales badly (1)
Cash (2 pts): cash from operations ≥ 70% of profit over the period (2), or ≥ 40% (1)
Balance sheet (2 pts): debt-to-equity ≤ 0.5 (1); interest covered ≥ 4× or no debt (1)
Valuation (1 pt): PEG ≤ 1.5, or P/E ≤ 40 where growth is unclear
Listed from 6 points; alert when a stock first reaches 8. Needs at least 3 years of data
Not covered (no free source): promoter holding and pledges

screens.title: Corporate actions
screens.description: Upcoming dividends, splits, bonus and rights issues, shown only while there is still time to buy.
rules: Ex-date still ahead; the last day to buy is the trading day before the ex-date (T+1 settlement)
Dividend yield = dividend per share ÷ last close; alert at 3% or more
Alert only when at least 2 trading days are left to buy
Rights issues show the discount of the issue price to the market price
Trading days count weekdays only; exchange holidays are not yet excluded

screens.title: Narrative / operator
screens.description: Filings that often come with story-driven stocks: control changes, cheap equity to promoters, order headlines, exchange volume queries.
rules: Open offer / control change: 2 points
Preferential issue / warrants: 2 points
Exchange price/volume query: 2 points
Rights issue: 1 point
Order / contract / MoU: 1 point
Merger / amalgamation: 1 point
Fund-raising approval: 1 point
Split / bonus: 1 point
Each type counts once per stock over the last 365 days; listed from 2 points, alert at 5

screens.title: Bulk & block deals
screens.description: Large trades disclosed by NSE over the last 10 sessions, netted per stock.
rules: Bulk deals (≥0.5% of shares in a day) and block deals from NSE's daily files
Buys and sells netted per stock over the last 10 sessions
Listed when net value is at least ₹1 crore either way; net buyers score higher
